chapter.title: OF OFFENCES AFFECTING THE HUMAN BODY

heading: Abduction.
text: Whoever by force compels, or by any deceitful means induces, any person to go from any place, is said to abduct that person.
status_note: The Act is repealed. Kept in India Code's 'Repeal Acts' collection; record title reads 'The Indian Penal Code, 45 of 1860 (Rep., Act 45 of 2023)' (read 2026-11-21)
